Pharmaceutical Supply Intelligence

Improve pharmaceutical supply decisions by mapping external signals to your internal records

Ceres helps pharmaceutical companies connect purchase orders, SKU records, supplier information, inventory plans, and Excel-based workflows to outside conditions like weather, logistics disruption, raw material changes, geopolitical risk, public supplier signals, and other leading indicators of delay.

Book a Demo arrow_forward

Built for pharmaceutical supply chain, sourcing, planning, and resiliency teams that need earlier visibility into supplier and product risk.

Internal supply data shows what happened. It does not always show what is coming.

Pharmaceutical companies already have purchase orders, supplier records, SKU data, expected delivery dates, inventory positions, and planning workflows inside ERP systems and spreadsheets. The harder problem is seeing the outside conditions that may disrupt supply before the delay is obvious in internal reporting.

External signals are not a side input. They materially improve the analysis.

In prior pharmaceutical predictive work, Ceres used purchase order data together with external datasets to identify leading indicators of disruption across generic drug product lines. The external signals improved model performance and helped create earlier visibility into delay risk, including forward-looking signal windows measured in months, not just days.
